faq.a: It means he learned advanced mathematics without being in a formal school or university setting. He was incredibly gifted and taught himself through reading and practice. Asks: Did he go to college? What does it mean to teach yourself math?
asks: How did he learn math without a teacher?

faq.q: Why was Hardy important to him?
faq.a: Hardy was a respected mathematician who helped Ramanujan structure and prove his amazing ideas. Their collaboration was crucial for publishing his work. Asks: Did Hardy teach him? Was their friendship important?
asks: Who helped him prove his theories?
What was the relationship between the two men?

faq.q: What is the difference between a simple sum and an infinite series?
faq.a: A simple sum adds a fixed number of terms, while an infinite series adds an endless number of terms. The value it approaches is called the sum. Asks: Does it go on forever? Can you give an example?
asks: What is the difference between adding things and a series?
How do you calculate an infinite sum?

quiz.say: If a series approaches a final value, what is that value called?

options.show: The sum of the infinite series.
options.say: The sum of the infinite series.

quiz.why: The sum represents the limit that the terms get closer and closer to.

wrong.0: This is wrong because the sum considers all the terms, not just the beginning one.
wrong.1: This is wrong because an infinite series has no actual last term.
wrong.2: This is wrong because the common difference applies to arithmetic progressions, not all series.
